title: The Allocation of Talent and Financial Development, 1897 to 1936
eligible_reason: Continuous treatment with a single common date: lnquota_post = log civil-examination quota x post, post = 1 for 1905-1936 (abolition of the exam) in every prefecture. No binary staggered adoption.
design_notes: Prefecture x year panel 1897-1936 (prefecture_data.dta). Tables 2-8: reghdfe banks (BanksAll, BanksChinese, bankers) on lnquota_post, absorb(year idprefID), cluster idprefID, with and without baseline-characteristic x post controls; year-by-year lnquota interactions for dynamics; cross-sectional regressions on lnquota for 1919/1934/1936. Table 9: prefecture-industry cross-section.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment (lnquota x post); single common date 1905
